paper.title: CoverPrune: Coverage-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Optimal Transport
paper.abstract: While 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable spatial reasoning capabilities, they suffer from massive visual token counts that create severe computational bottlenecks during inference. Existing token pruning methods primarily rely on diversity-based selection, discarding similar tokens to maximize dispersion. However, in 3D environments, this approach frequently drops representative prototype tokens in favor of outliers, breaking the multi-view consistencies and geometr

summary.core_problem: 3D VLM 推理时视觉 token 数量过大，现有基于多样性的 token pruning 容易保留离群点、丢掉代表性几何证据，影响空间推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它把 3D VLM 的 token 裁剪从“选得更分散”改成“覆盖视觉证据”，对多视角/3D 输入的 token 压缩有一定方法参考，但问题域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoverPrune，一个 training-free 的推理期 pruning 框架，将 token 子集选择表述为 Optimal Transport 问题。方法设计 Feature-Spatial-Temporal transport cost 和 target capacity，用特征、空间、时间信息共同衡量候选 token 对原始视觉证据的覆盖能力，并用近似求解避免组合优化不可 tractable。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、压缩率和性能数字。实验应主要围绕 3D VLM 空间推理任务，对比 diversity-based pruning，评估 token 削减后的准确率、几何一致性和推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学深圳国际研究生院和 LIGHTSPEED。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D VLMs carry very large visual-token budgets at inference time, and diversity-based pruning can keep outliers while dropping representative geometric evidence needed for spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. Its useful idea is to frame 3D token pruning as evidence coverage rather than dispersion, though the setting is narrower than general LLM or VLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoverPrune is a training-free pruning framework that formulates subset selection as an Optimal Transport problem. It introduces a Feature-Spatial-Temporal transport cost and target capacity so selected tokens cover the original evidence in feature, spatial, and temporal dimensions, with an approximate solver for the otherwise combinatorial objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, pruning ratios, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares against diversity-driven pruning on 3D VLM spatial reasoning tasks, measuring accuracy, geometric consistency, and inference cost after token reduction.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School and LIGHTSPEED.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pruning objective 即可；coverage 比 diversity 更适合 3D token，但离通用 VLM pretrain 还有距离。
recommendation.en: Skim the pruning objective only; coverage is a cleaner prior than diversity for 3D tokens, but it is not a general VLM pretraining result.

paper.title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
paper.abstract: Abundant visual information strengthens vision-language model (VLM) perception, yet massive visual tokens raise inference costs. Existing visual token pruning methods rely on similarity-based guidance, which exploits pairwise text-vision and vision-vision token correlations for compression. However, such methods only capture local layer-level signals and overlook the whole inference process in VLM. In this paper, we revisit VLM inference and present a new efficient guidance scheme that complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 推理中的视觉 token 冗余问题：现有剪枝方法多依赖单层 attention 或相似度，缺少对文本 token 在深层逐步吸收视觉信息这一过程的刻画。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在多模态表示动态分析和推理效率。论文给出一个清晰观察：随着 LLM 层数加深，一部分视觉 token 信息会被文本表示吸收，因此继续保留所有视觉 token 的边际收益下降。这对 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token budget、跨模态 token routing 都有启发。训练阶段可以考虑让视觉信息在合适层被压缩到文本或共享 latent 中；推理阶段则可以用残差信息而不是原始相似度判断哪些视觉 token 仍有保留价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析指标 Cross Modal Absorption，简称 CMA。它在每一层把中心化后的视觉 token 矩阵投影到文本 token 张成的子空间中，用投影可解释的 Frobenius norm 比例衡量视觉信息被文本子空间吸收的程度。CMA 是层级指标，用来描述随层深变化的整体趋势。第二步是 token 级剪枝指标 Cross Modal Residual，简称 CMR。对每个视觉 token，用 Tikhonov regularization 做正则化最小二乘投影，计算它在文本子空间之外的残差；残差越大，说明该 token 仍包含文本表示尚未解释的视觉信息。最终方法 SIEVE 把三类信号结合起来：CMR 衡量视觉独特性，text-to-visual attention 衡量任务相关性，残差空间中的 diversity selection 去除冗余。与只看原特征相似度的剪枝相比，残差空间先剥离了已被文本解释的成分，因此更适合找互补视觉信息。方法不训练模型，可插入已有 VLM。
summary.experiments: 分析部分在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 32 层上进行，覆盖 TextVQA、POPE、MME 三个 benchmark，共 16,284 个样本。CMA 随层数单调增加：POPE 从 0.008 到 0.209，MME 从 0.009 到 0.217，TextVQA 从 0.017 到 0.396；三者与层深的 Spearman 相关系数均为 +0.99。这说明视觉表征确实逐层变得更容易由文本子空间解释。方法实验覆盖三种 VLM 架构和八个 benchmark，报告在降低计算和显存开销的同时保持任务表现，并带来实际推理加速。给定正文没有完整提供各压缩率、延迟、显存和精度表，因此具体收益需要读实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Analysis 中 CMA 的定义和 Figure 2，因为这是方法成立的核心证据。再看 Method 中 CMR 的正则化投影公式、SIEVE 如何融合 CMR、attention relevance 和 residual-space diversity。实验部分重点看不同保留率下的 accuracy-latency 曲线、跨 LLaVA / InternVL / Qwen-VL 等架构的稳定性，以及 OCR、幻觉检测、多图或高分辨率场景是否掉点。消融部分要确认 CMR 单独使用、attention 单独使用、diversity 单独使用的贡献，避免把收益误认为只是常规 attention pruning 的变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual-token redundancy in VLM inference. Existing pruning methods mostly use single-layer attention or feature similarity, while this work models a process that happens across depth: text tokens gradually absorb part of the visual information.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal representation dynamics and efficient inference, rather than pretraining objectives. The key observation is that visual information does not remain fully isolated in visual tokens; deeper text states can explain an increasing portion of it. This has implications for native multimodal pretraining, visual token budgets, and cross-modal routing. During training, one may encourage visual information to move into shared or textual latent states at the right depth. During inference, pruning can focus on visual residuals that have not yet been explained by text.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first defines Cross Modal Absorption, or CMA. At each layer, centered visual-token representations are projected onto the subspace spanned by text-token representations, and the explainable Frobenius-norm ratio measures how much visual information has been absorbed by the text subspace. CMA is a layer-level diagnostic. For pruning, the paper introduces Cross Modal Residual, or CMR, at the token level. Each visual token is projected onto the text subspace using Tikhonov-regularized least squares, and the residual measures the visual information not explained by text. A larger residual means the token still carries complementary visual content. The final method, SIEVE, combines CMR for visual distinctiveness, text-to-visual attention for task relevance, and diversity selection in the residual space to reduce redundancy. It is training-free and can be applied to existing VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The representation analysis uses all 32 layers of LLaVA-1.5-7B on TextVQA, POPE, and MME, with 16,284 samples in total. CMA increases monotonically with depth: from 0.008 to 0.209 on POPE, from 0.009 to 0.217 on MME, and from 0.017 to 0.396 on TextVQA. The Spearman correlation with layer depth is +0.99 for all three benchmarks. This provides direct evidence that deeper text representations explain more visual-token content. The pruning experiments cover three VLM architectures and eight benchmarks, reporting reduced compute and memory with practical inference acceleration while maintaining task performance. The provided text does not include the full accuracy, latency, memory, or pruning-ratio tables, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the CMA definition and Figure 2, since they motivate the whole method. Then read the CMR derivation, especially the regularized projection onto the text subspace, and how SIEVE combines CMR, attention relevance, and residual-space diversity. In the experiments, focus on accuracy-latency trade-off curves, robustness across different VLM backbones, and behavior on OCR-heavy, hallucination-sensitive, high-resolution, or multi-image inputs. The ablations should be checked carefully: CMR alone, attention alone, diversity alone, and their combinations determine whether the method is more than a variant of standard attention-based pruning.

recommendation.zh: CMA 这个度量可借鉴到 VLM KV-cache 压缩，看方法和图即可，不必复现。
recommendation.en: The CMA metric is a useful angle for VLM KV-cache compression; read the method and figures, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: Not All Redundant Tokens Are Alike: Analyzing Visual Token Pruning through Token Roles
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process an image as a sequence of visual tokens, which creates a substantial computational bottleneck during inference. Recent visual token pruning methods address this issue by removing seemingly redundant tokens, yet it remains unclear how these pruning decisions relate to the functional roles of visual tokens. In this work, we analyze visual token pruning through the lens of token roles identified by EmbedLens. We first show that representative pruning methods ex

summary.core_problem: 分析 VLM 中视觉 token 剪枝决策与 token 功能角色之间的关系，解释为何看似冗余的 token 被剪去后会影响性能。
summary.importance: 属于视觉 token 剪枝的机制分析工作；主要贡献是用 EmbedLens 定义的 token role 审视现有剪枝方法的偏差，并发现弱语义 token 不一定可安全删除。
summary.technical_approach: 先用 EmbedLens 识别视觉 token 角色，比较多种代表性剪枝方法的角色偏好；再改进 token-role 分配流程，设计 role-protected pruning 变体，观察保留不同角色 token 对下游性能的影响。
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉 token 剪枝方法上做角色偏差分析和受控剪枝实验；结果显示保留 non-alive tokens 有时能维持或提升性能。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Analyze how visual token pruning decisions in VLMs relate to the functional roles of visual tokens, and why pruning seemingly redundant tokens can hurt behavior.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis of visual token pruning; its main contribution is using EmbedLens-derived token roles to reveal biases in existing pruners and show that weakly semantic tokens are not always safe to remove.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies token roles with EmbedLens, compares role biases across representative pruning methods, refines the role-assignment procedure, and evaluates role-protected pruning variants that preserve specific token groups.
summary_en.experiments: It analyzes role biases and runs controlled pruning experiments across several pruning methods; preserving non-alive tokens sometimes maintains or improves performance. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 token 剪枝的小分析，结论对 VLM 推理优化有边际参考；只看 role-protected pruning 的对照实验即可。
recommendation.en: A small analysis of visual token pruning; marginally useful for VLM inference work. Read only the role-protected pruning comparisons.

paper.title: DIVE: Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual inputs in vision-language models (VLMs) are often encoded into substantially longer token sequences than text, making visual tokens a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Abundant recent methods address this bottleneck by scoring token importance and pruning low-scoring tokens in a single pass. However, one-shot scoring is insufficient because a token's prompt-relevant usefulness depends on the evidence already retained. Motivated by this insight, we introduce DIVE (Dynamic Iterative

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中一次性视觉 token 评分无法考虑已保留证据、导致剪枝 token 与 prompt 需求不互补的问题。
summary.importance: 方法型工作，把视觉 token 剪枝重新表述为动态证据构建；对 VLM 推理加速有参考，但属于训练-free 的增量式剪枝改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DIVE，一个 training-free 框架：迭代选择当前 residual-conditioned score 最高的 token，更新视觉和 prompt residual 以折扣已解释证据，再重新评估剩余 token，形成互补的保留集合。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个图像理解 benchmark 上评估；摘要未给出具体模型、baseline 或数值结果，仅说明该 select-update-re-evaluate 流程用于构建 prompt-relevant visual evidence。

summary_en.core_problem: One-shot visual token scoring in VLMs ignores which evidence has already been retained, so pruned tokens may fail to complement the prompt-relevant evidence set.
summary_en.importance: A methods paper that recasts visual token pruning as dynamic evidence construction; relevant to VLM inference acceleration, but it is an incremental training-free pruning improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: DIVE repeatedly selects the token with the highest residual-conditioned score, updates visual and prompt residuals to discount explained evidence, and re-evaluates remaining tokens to build a complementary retained set.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight image-understanding benchmarks. The abstract does not report model names, baselines, or numeric results, only describing the select-update-re-evaluate procedure.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free 的迭代剪枝技巧，思路清楚但更像 VLM 推理工程改进；看 residual 更新公式和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free iterative pruning trick with a clear idea, but mostly VLM inference engineering. Read the residual update and main table.

paper.title: When Do Fewer Visual Tokens Accelerate Multimodal Inference? A Break-Even Study Across Decision Locations and Hardware
paper.abstract: Fewer visual tokens do not guarantee lower end-to-end latency. We evaluate break-even with a reproducible protocol that accounts for decision overhead, shared work, and the operators each policy can avoid. A stage-level decomposition reconciles these components with measured end-to-end latency. In a 30-example pilot, the two tested autoregressive probes remain slower than Full despite state reuse. A lightweight post-vision predictor yields paired confidence intervals below zero on RTX 3090 and A

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型中视觉token剪枝、合并、动态分辨率等减少token的方法，常被默认能降低端到端推理延迟，但实际决策开销、决策位置（视觉编码前/后）、硬件算子特性都会抵消潜在计算收益，目前缺乏可复现的盈亏平衡分析框架，用于判断自适应视觉预算何时能真正带来可测量的延迟下降。
summary.importance: 纠正了MLLM效率优化领域中“FLOPs下降/token减少比例等价于延迟下降”的普遍认知错位。对MLLM视觉tokenizer设计、动态分辨率策略、预训练阶段的效率目标设定有直接参考：不能仅追求编码后的token稀疏度，必须将全链路推理成本纳入设计指标。提出的可复现盈亏平衡协议可直接复用至其他MLLM效率优化方法的评估。
summary.technical_approach: 首先定义单调安全的后视觉预算（要求保留token比例提升时答案质量不下降，避免将偶然的低预算正确样本误判为安全），再将端到端延迟拆分为三类互斥开销：共享计算（决策和推理共用的部分，如可复用的视觉编码特征）、仅决策开销（特征聚合、策略推理、路由等仅用于选择预算的计算）、仅执行开销（剩余预处理、视觉编码、LLM预填充/解码）。设计三级盈亏平衡检验标准：观测到延迟降低、配对置信区间统计显著、保守的全对Holm校正后仍显著。评估四类策略：后视觉固定阈值Static、自回归探针（Confidence Gate、Counterfactual Gate）、视觉前图像尺寸规则、后视觉Oracle上限。
summary.experiments: 在VQAv2、TextVQA、ChartQA共2600个样本、18200次运行上完成 profiling。后视觉Oracle在Full模型答对的样本上平均仅需保留23.92%的token（VQAv2为16.5%，TextVQA为18.01%，ChartQA为41.07%；41.74%的样本仅需5%token即可，仅4.13%的样本需要100%token），但在98.5%的单调安全验证约束下，可选的固定预算仍为100%。30样本预实验中，两种自回归探针即使复用状态，延迟仍高于Full模型。RTX 3090和A100上，Static-0.900的配对延迟差置信区间低于0，且Holm校正后仍显著；图像尺寸规则也有收益但校正后失去显著性。A100上Static移除的token量是规则的近8倍，但延迟节省反而更少，说明硬件环境会反转token移除量与延迟收益的相关性；规则的收益集中在高分辨率场景文本的长尾样本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第2节的延迟分解框架与三级盈亏平衡检验定义（核心方法贡献），再看第3节的Oracle预算统计与硬件交互实验结果。可跳过自回归探针的具体设计细节与统计校正的数学推导，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Visual token reduction methods (pruning, merging, dynamic resolution) for multimodal LLMs are often assumed to reduce end-to-end inference latency, but decision overhead, decision placement (pre/post vision encoder), and hardware-specific operator characteristics can erase potential compute gains. No reproducible break-even analysis framework exists to determine when adaptive visual budgeting actually delivers measurable latency reductions.
summary_en.importance: Corrects the widespread misalignment between FLOPs/token reduction metrics and real-world latency in MLLM efficiency research. Offers direct guidance for MLLM visual tokenizer design, dynamic resolution strategy, and pretraining efficiency objective setting: full-pipeline inference cost must be incorporated into design targets instead of only pursuing post-encoding token sparsity. The proposed reproducible break-even protocol can be directly reused for evaluating other MLLM efficiency optimization methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: First defines a monotone-safe post-vision budget (requires answer quality to not degrade as retained token ratio increases, to avoid misclassifying accidental low-budget successes as safe). Decomposes end-to-end latency into three mutually exclusive components: shared computation (used for both decision and inference, e.g. reusable visual encoder features), decision-only overhead (feature aggregation, policy inference, routing used exclusively for budget selection), and execution-only work (remaining preprocessing, vision encoding, LLM prefill/decode). Designs a three-tier break-even test: observed latency reduction, statistically significant paired confidence interval, and significance retained after conservative all-pairs Holm correction. Evaluates four policy classes: post-vision fixed-threshold Static, autoregressive probes (Confidence Gate, Counterfactual Gate), pre-vision image-size rule, and post-vision upper-bound Oracle.
summary_en.experiments: Profiled 2,600 examples from VQAv2, TextVQA, ChartQA across 18,200 runs. The post-vision Oracle retains 23.92% of visual tokens on average for Full-correct examples (16.5% for VQAv2, 18.01% for TextVQA, 41.07% for ChartQA; 41.74% of samples are safe with 5% tokens, only 4.13% require 100%), but a 98.5% monotone-safe validation constraint forces the valid fixed budget to 100%. In a 30-example pilot, both autoregressive probes remain slower than Full despite state reuse. On RTX 3090 and A100, Static-0.900 shows significant paired latency reductions retained after Holm correction; the Image-Size Rule also shows gains but loses significance post-correction. On A100, Static removes ~8x more tokens than the Rule but delivers smaller latency savings, showing hardware environments can reverse the correlation between token removal volume and latency gains. Rule gains are concentrated in the high-resolution scene-text tail.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2's latency decomposition framework and three-tier break-even test definitions (core methodological contribution), then Section 3's Oracle budget statistics and hardware interaction results. Skip detailed autoregressive probe design and statistical correction derivations; estimated reading time 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 打破了'减少视觉 token 必然加速'的直觉，详细拆解了 VLM 推理的 overhead，做 VLM serving 和优化的同学值得看其 profiling 方法。
recommendation.en: Challenges the intuition that fewer visual tokens guarantee speedup; provides a detailed breakdown of VLM inference overhead, valuable for VLM serving and optimization.

paper.title: GSTEP: Global Spatio-Temporal Density-Driven Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Video large language models (VideoLLMs) achieve strong video understanding performance, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of redundant spatio-temporal visual tokens in long videos. Existing token pruning methods alleviate this cost by reducing redundant tokens, yet most of them rely on segment-level local pruning, where videos are partitioned into isolated segments and tokens are selected independently within each segment. Such designs may under-preserve short but sem

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频LLM token剪枝方法依赖片段级局部剪枝，导致语义密集短片段被欠采样、全局关键但局部不显著的token被误删的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出即插即用的全局时空密度驱动剪枝框架GSTEP，将视频建模为连续时空信息流，统一处理时空维度的冗余token
summary.technical_approach: 1) 将视频建模为连续时空信息流，而非孤立片段；2) 构造token级时空密度：结合平滑中心化帧级变化信号得到的连续时间密度，与帧内基于视觉特征显著性的空间密度；3) 根据全局时空密度自适应保留高信息密度token，支持任意VideoLLM backbone的即插即用
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型配置、数据集与量化提升，核心贡献为方法框架，需查阅正文获取视频理解任务精度、推理速度与显存占用的实验结果
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、合肥工业大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses limitations of existing VideoLLM token pruning methods that rely on segment-level local pruning, leading to under-sampling of semantically dense short segments and erroneous deletion of globally critical but locally non-salient tokens
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes GSTEP, a plug-and-play global spatio-temporal density-driven pruning framework, modeling video as a continuous spatio-temporal information flow to unify redundancy reduction across both dimensions
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Models video as continuous spatio-temporal information flow instead of isolated segments; 2) Constructs token-level spatio-temporal density by combining continuous temporal density (from smoothed centered frame change signals) and intra-frame spatial density (based on visual feature saliency); 3) Adaptively retains high-information-density tokens based on global density, plug-and-play for any VideoLLM backbone
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose specific model configurations, datasets, or quantitative gains; core contribution is methodological framework, refer to full text for video understanding accuracy, inference speed, and memory footprint results
summary_en.authors_note: University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei University of Technology team

recommendation.zh: 视频LLM token剪枝的增量改进，做多模态推理效率的可看§3的时空密度构造方法，纯文本预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for VideoLLM token pruning; multimodal inference teams can check §3 spatio-temporal density construction, no need for text-only pretrain researchers to read deeply
