paper.title: Adaptive Two-Stage Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Inference in Video-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models excel at image and video understanding but suffer from high inference latency due to the need to process thousands of tokens per image, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices and in real-time surveillance applications. This challenge is further amplified in video processing, where multiple frames must be analyzed simultaneously. Existing token reduction techniques are largely developed for single-image inputs and therefore fail to account for the te

summary.core_problem: 降低视频语言模型推理时大量视觉 token 带来的延迟和算力开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，关注视频输入中的时间冗余和样本间冗余差异；对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对长视频 VLM serving 和 token budget 设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两阶段自适应视觉 token pruning。核心思想是先利用视频帧间冗余进行粗粒度裁剪，再按内容复杂度动态决定保留比例，避免单图方法常见的固定 pruning ratio。摘要未完整披露两阶段的具体打分函数和裁剪准则。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型参数量、视频数据集、baseline 名称或延迟/精度数值；仅说明目标是在视频语言模型推理中减少 token 数，同时保留关键信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets inference latency in video-language models caused by processing thousands of visual tokens per video.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It focuses on temporal redundancy and input-dependent redundancy in videos; it is not a direct pretraining result, but it is relevant for long-video VLM serving and token-budget design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a two-stage adaptive visual-token pruning strategy. The main idea is to exploit inter-frame redundancy and then choose content-dependent pruning levels instead of applying a fixed pruning ratio inherited from image-based methods. The supplied abstract does not expose the full scoring or pruning formulation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, datasets, baseline names, or latency/accuracy numbers; it frames the evaluation around reducing visual tokens while preserving video-language understanding performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融表即可；若没有按视频复杂度分桶的精度-延迟曲线，结论只能当 serving heuristic。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; without accuracy-latency curves bucketed by video complexity, treat it as a serving heuristic.

paper.title: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents
paper.abstract: Embodied agents replan frequently to recover from execution drift, partial observability, and coordination hazards, but each LLM-based replanning call can consume an accumulated textual context that grows over time and across agents. Once this context becomes large, replanning latency develops heavy tails and can miss real-time deadlines even when task success remains high, a failure mode that is hard to detect from average latency or success alone. We present BRACE, a controller that formulates

summary.core_problem: 具身智能体在执行漂移、局部可观测和多智能体协作中需要频繁重规划，但基于 LLM 的重规划调用会累积越来越长的文本上下文。上下文膨胀后，重规划延迟出现重尾，即使任务成功率仍然很高，也会大量违反实时延迟约束；平均延迟和成功率无法暴露这种失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，更偏向智能体系统与推理侧上下文工程。但它把“重规划调用”当作一个有 token 预算、延迟 SLO 和阶段记账的系统原语，并指出成功率可能掩盖尾延迟问题，这对长上下文 agent、多智能体系统和 KV/context 效率研究有参考价值。E-RECAP 的逐层 token 剪枝也属于推理上下文压缩方向。
summary.technical_approach: BRACE 是一个预算化重规划控制器。每次触发时，它决定是否重规划、选择哪种重规划模式，并为压缩后送入 planner 的 token 数和端到端延迟设定预算。控制器包含 cooldown/commit 窗口以避免快速振荡，也支持在连续失败后临时放宽预算的 failure-aware override。调用路径上可插入上下文压缩、检索、plan caching、通信压缩等模块，并按 context compression、retrieval、planning 等阶段记录 token 和延迟。E-RECAP 是其中的成本感知渐进式 token 剪枝模块：训练模型预测 token 重要性，在选定 transformer 层进行剪枝，保留头尾 token，并按预测效用选择其余 token。
summary.experiments: 在 Habitat-Lab 多智能体导航场景中，E-RECAP 将每次重规划调用的 token 数减少 71–76%，重规划延迟降低 2.1–2.6 倍，同时成功率和按路径长度加权的成功率基本不变。在 Meta Habitat 导航、shortest-path-noise 执行、2500 ms 重规划 SLO 下，无预算基线虽然达到 100% 成功率，却在 85.5% 的重规划调用上违反 SLO；加入 E-RECAP/BRACE 后，违反率降至 4.7%，成功率没有下降。论文还覆盖 manipulation/coordination、多智能体 traffic benchmark、更难设置以及真实机器人和跨平台实验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看 Introduction 中“100% 成功率但 85.5% SLO 违反”的问题定义、Table 2 的尾延迟结果、Figure 2 的控制器调用路径，以及 E-RECAP 的逐层剪枝设计。若关注上下文压缩，可进一步看 progressive pruning 和 budget-matched baselines 的消融；若只关注 agent systems，看控制器状态机和 phase accounting 即可。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Embodied agents replan frequently to recover from execution drift, partial observability, and coordination hazards, but LLM-based replanning calls accumulate growing textual context. As context expands, replanning latency becomes heavy-tailed and can repeatedly miss real-time deadlines even when task success remains high. Average latency and success rates alone do not reveal this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an agent-systems and context-engineering contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its relevance is in treating replanning as a budgeted primitive with explicit token budgets, latency SLOs, and phase-level accounting, and in showing that success can hide persistent tail-latency violations. The trained token-pruning module is also relevant to inference-time context compression for long-context and multi-agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: BRACE is a budgeted replanning controller. At each trigger, it decides whether to replan, selects a replanning mode, and allocates a token budget for the compressed planner input plus an end-to-end latency SLO. It uses cooldown/commit windows to reduce oscillation and failure-aware overrides that temporarily relax budgets after repeated failures. The replanning call path is modular and can include context compression, retrieval, plan caching, and communication compression, with per-phase accounting for tokens and latency. E-RECAP is a cost-aware progressive token-pruning module trained to predict token importance; it prunes across selected transformer layers, preserves head and tail tokens, and retains remaining tokens by predicted utility.
summary_en.experiments: On Habitat-Lab navigation with multi-agent context growth, E-RECAP reduces tokens per replanning call by 71–76% and replanning latency by 2.1–2.6× with little change in success or path-length-weighted success. On Meta Habitat navigation with shortest-path-noise execution and a 2500 ms replanning SLO, a no-budget baseline achieves 100% success but violates the SLO on 85.5% of replanning calls; with E-RECAP/BRACE the violation rate drops to 4.7% without reducing success. The evaluation also includes manipulation/coordination, multi-agent traffic, harder settings, real-robot experiments, and cross-platform coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the systems framing. Focus on the motivating result in the introduction, Table 2 for SLO violations, Figure 2 for the controller and call path, and the E-RECAP pruning design. Readers interested in context compression should inspect the progressive-pruning and budget-matched baseline ablations; those interested in agent control can focus on the controller state machine and phase accounting. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Agent 长上下文推理的延迟问题，提出的 token 剪枝策略 (E-RECAP) 对优化长上下文推理效率有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Focuses on the latency issue of long-context reasoning in Agents; the proposed token pruning strategy (E-RECAP) offers reference value for optimizing long-context inference efficiency.

paper.title: Capturing Token Tendencies for Training-Free Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: While visual token pruning is essential for efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing training-free methods suffer from a critical limitation: they rely on static, instantaneous heuristics to perform irreversible filtering. This approach ignores the hierarchical nature of MLLMs, where token importance often evolves dynamically rather than remaining fixed across layers. Consequently, tokens essential for deep-layer reasoning are often prematurely discarded by shallow-layer esti

summary.core_problem: 训练免费视觉 token pruning 往往根据浅层瞬时重要性一次性丢 token，导致深层推理才变重要的视觉线索被过早删除。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM 推理效率方法。它提出 token 重要性随层变化的建模视角，对多模态上下文压缩、视觉 token budget 分配和 serving 侧延迟优化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Trend-aware Pruning，把剪枝从单点打分改成跨层趋势建模。方法跟踪 attention flow 的 momentum，并加入动态校正机制：当某些早期分数低但后续语义重要性上升的 late-blooming tokens 出现时，选择性重新激活，降低不可逆剪枝造成的信息损失。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个实验中验证了该方法相对既有 training-free pruning 的优势，但未给出 MLLM 类型、token 保留率、任务集、baseline 或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Rongrong Ji，他长期从事视觉、多模态与高效模型研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Training-free visual token pruning in MLLMs often drops tokens using shallow, instantaneous importance scores, removing cues that only become important in deeper reasoning layers.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency method for MLLMs. Its useful idea is to treat token importance as a layer-wise trajectory, which matters for multimodal context compression, visual token budgeting, and serving latency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trend-aware Pruning reframes pruning from local score thresholding to temporal trajectory modeling across layers. It tracks the momentum of attention flow and uses dynamic rectification to reactivate late-blooming tokens whose early scores are low but whose semantic importance rises later.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims extensive experiments showing gains over existing training-free pruning methods, but does not provide the MLLM backbones, retention ratios, benchmarks, baselines, or numeric improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Rongrong Ji, known for work on vision, multimodal learning, and efficient models.

recommendation.zh: 只看 late-blooming token 的统计和消融；若现象稳，视觉 token 剪枝不能再只看浅层 saliency。
recommendation.en: Read the late-blooming-token statistics and ablations; if stable, visual pruning should not rely only on shallow saliency.

paper.title: Omni-Prune: Query-Aware Unified Token Pruning for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) are rapidly extending multimodal reasoning to cover synchronized audio and video. However, the resulting audio-video token sequences are long, leading to high prefill latency and GPU memory usage at inference time. Existing token pruning methods, designed mainly for vision-only inputs, miss both the cross-modal links between audio and video and the user query that decides which content matters. To bridge this gap, we present Omni-Prune, a training-free,

summary.core_problem: 支持音视频同步输入的全模态LLM存在音视频token序列过长的问题，导致推理预填充延迟高、显存占用大，现有视觉单模态剪枝方法忽略音视频跨模态关联与用户查询引导。
summary.importance: 提出首个针对音视频同步OmniLLM的免训练query感知token剪枝框架，在保留跨模态任务证据的前提下降低推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 训练-free流程：按音频显著性峰值划分自适应时间窗口，结合编码器注意力与文本查询相关性对音视频token统一打分，配对关联的音视频token保证共同保留，窗口内用K-medoids选择代表性token完成剪枝。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、测试基准与量化效果，仅说明方法可联合去除跨模态冗余、保留任务相关证据。

summary_en.core_problem: Omnimodal LLMs with synchronized audio-video inputs face long audio-video token sequences causing high prefill latency and memory usage; existing vision-only pruning methods ignore cross-modal links and user query guidance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first training-free, query-aware token pruning framework for synchronized audio-video OmniLLMs, reducing inference overhead while preserving task-relevant cross-modal evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The training-free pipeline splits sequences into adaptive time windows aligned with audio saliency peaks, scores audio/video tokens on a unified scale combining encoder attention and query relevance, pairs correlated audio-video tokens for joint retention, and uses K-medoids per window to select representative tokens.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model sizes, benchmarks, or quantitative results are disclosed in the abstract; the method is stated to jointly remove cross-modal redundancy while preserving task-relevant evidence.

recommendation.zh: 音视频多模态LLM的训练-free剪枝增量工作，无范式创新，作为多模态推理效率文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental training-free pruning work for audio-video multimodal LLMs with no paradigm innovation; keep as reference for multimodal inference efficiency, no deep read needed.

paper.title: PCA: Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation for Fast Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite advances in Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) that have displayed promising outcomes in video understanding, the redundancy in the long-duration frames remains a hindrance to efficient reasoning. This paper introduces a training-free $\mathbf{P}$ersistence-Aware $\mathbf{C}$ompression and $\mathbf{A}$ggregation (PCA) method designed to preserve high-fidelity raw visual information before the encoding stage. PCA can be built on arbitrary VLLMs and consists of two modules: 1) A Dynamic D

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLLM 推理中帧冗余很高，直接把大量帧送入视觉编码器和长上下文模块会带来显著计算浪费。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它关注视频 token 进入模型前的压缩与信息保真，对多模态长上下文 serving 和视频 token 选择有一定参考价值，但不是预训练方法或新建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 training-free 的 PCA，即 Persistence-Aware Compression and Aggregation。方法包含两个模块：Dynamic Downsampling 根据帧间相似度自适应删除冗余帧；Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement 将被选中关键帧邻域的时间上下文聚合回来，避免简单丢帧损失运动信息。它可外挂到任意 VLLM 前端，不需要重新训练基座模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 Video LLM baseline 上做了广泛实验，目标是在减少长上下文计算量的同时保持或提升性能。给定信息未包含具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度；结论以训练免费、压缩前置、性能不降为主。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Great Bay University、Sun Yat-sen University、Tencent Youtu Lab、Shenzhen University 等；Tencent Youtu 在视觉和多模态工程上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses redundant frames in long-video VLLM inference, where feeding dense frames into the visual encoder and long-context module wastes compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time efficiency method. It is relevant to multimodal serving and video token selection, but it does not introduce a new pretraining objective, tokenizer, or base-model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: PCA is a training-free front-end method with two parts. Dynamic Downsampling removes redundant frames based on frame-wise similarity. Persistence-Aware Motion Enhancement aggregates temporal context from neighboring frames into each selected keyframe so that aggressive frame reduction does not simply discard motion information. The method is designed to plug into arbitrary VLLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments across baseline Video LLMs, claiming reduced long-context computation and improved baseline performance. The provided metadata does not include exact model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Great Bay University, Sun Yat-sen University, Tencent Youtu Lab, and Shenzhen University. Tencent Youtu has a strong applied vision and multimodal engineering track record.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和压缩率-性能曲线；若结果干净，可作为视频 token pruning 的 serving baseline。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and compression-performance curves; if clean, it is a useful serving baseline for video token pruning.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Great Bay University
Dongguan Key Laboratory for Intelligence and Information Technology

paper.title: Look Less, Think Faster: Joint Token-Compute Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance across vision-language tasks. However, their high inference cost, arising from both the large number of input visual tokens and the heavy computation of the large language model (LLM), remains a key barrier to practical deployment. Recent work attempts to reduce the cost by adaptively optimizing individual dimensions, e.g., pruning redundant visual tokens or skipping LLM layers and heads. Nonetheless, prior ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 MLLM 推理成本的联合自适应分配问题：视觉 token 数量、LLM 层深度、注意力头和 FFN 宽度都会影响 prefill 成本，但已有方法通常只单独做 token pruning 或 layer/head skipping，无法根据输入内容和实时算力预算做全局取舍。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，更偏高效推理。但它对 MLLM 架构设计有启发：视觉信息密度和语言模型推理深度不是独立变量。简单样本可以少看图、少走层；复杂样本可能需要保留更多视觉上下文，同时减少部分模型宽度或深度。这个思路也提示多模态基座模型在训练阶段可以考虑引入预算条件化能力，而不是只在推理时做后处理剪枝。
summary.technical_approach: SmartVL 把三类计算开关放到一个框架里联合控制：第一是视觉侧 token controller，决定保留多少视觉 token；第二是 LLM 侧 compute controller，决定层、头和宽度等计算路径；第三是预算条件化机制，把输入中间特征和目标 FLOPs budget 融合后作为控制器决策依据。核心区别在于，它不把视觉剪枝和语言模型跳层当成两个串联启发式模块，而是用可微资源估计器直接约束 FLOPs 偏差，并在推理时用 bounding mechanism 严格压住预算。这样做的目标是避免两个常见问题：视觉 token 被局部冗余指标误删后造成语义信息损失；模型跳层模块在默认全量视觉 token 的假设下工作，无法适配前面已经被压缩过的输入。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 VQAv2、GQA、TextVQA、ScienceQA、POPE、MMBench、VizWiz 等常见 MLLM 评测。对比对象包括单维 token pruning 方法 LLaVA-PruMerge+、FastV，计算自适应方法 AdaLLaVA，以及把 AdaLLaVA 和 PruMerge 组合起来的朴素两阶段方案。主要结果是 SmartVL 在不同 FLOPs budget 下给出更好的准确率-计算量曲线。论文明确给出的数字是：在 50% compute 下，SmartVL 相比 AdaLLaVA 有 6.6% accuracy gain，并且在更高算力区间仍保持优势。实验重点不只是绝对分数，而是说明联合调度优于单独剪 token、单独跳层，或把两个模块简单拼接。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中关于三类计算轴的分解，以及为什么 token redundancy 和 LLM reasoning complexity 存在耦合；再看方法部分的两个 controller、budget-conditioned feature fusion、differentiable resource estimator 和 bounding mechanism。实验部分优先看 FLOPs-accuracy Pareto 曲线和 AdaLLaVA-PruMerge 这类组合 baseline，因为它能判断联合训练是否真的优于工程拼接。若只关心预训练，可快速看结论，把它作为动态计算分配和预算条件化建模的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses joint adaptive inference for multimodal LLMs. Visual token count, LLM depth, and model width all contribute to prefill cost, but prior methods usually optimize only one axis, such as token pruning or layer/head skipping. This misses the fact that visual information density and downstream reasoning compute should be allocated together under a runtime FLOPs budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient MLLM inference rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the coupling between visual token selection and language-model compute. The result suggests that multimodal models may benefit from being trained with budget-conditioned computation, instead of relying only on post-hoc pruning or skipping rules at deployment time.
summary_en.technical_approach: SmartVL jointly controls sequence length, model depth, and model width. It uses a vision-side token controller to select visual tokens and an LLM-side compute controller to allocate computation inside the language model. Both controllers are conditioned on fused intermediate representations that encode input content and the target compute budget. A differentiable resource estimator penalizes deviations from the desired FLOPs, and an inference-time bounding mechanism enforces the budget. The main distinction from earlier work is that token pruning and compute skipping are not treated as independent heuristics. The framework lets the model trade off retaining more visual context against activating more reasoning capacity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers VQAv2, GQA, TextVQA, ScienceQA, POPE, MMBench, and VizWiz. Baselines include LLaVA-PruMerge+, FastV, AdaLLaVA, and a composed AdaLLaVA-PruMerge pipeline. The reported result is that SmartVL gives a better accuracy-compute Pareto frontier than single-axis adaptation and naive composition. One concrete number in the manuscript is a 6.6% accuracy gain over AdaLLaVA at 50% compute, with the advantage maintained across higher FLOPs levels.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction for the cost decomposition into sequence length, depth, and width, and for the argument that visual redundancy and LLM reasoning complexity are coupled. Then inspect the method details for the two controllers, budget-conditioned feature fusion, differentiable resource estimator, and bounding rule. In the experiments, focus on the FLOPs-accuracy curves and the comparison against AdaLLaVA-PruMerge, since that baseline tests whether joint scheduling is better than simply composing two separate efficiency modules.

recommendation.zh: MLLM部署侧的联合剪枝思路，与预训练无直接关系；只看§3框架图和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Joint token-compute pruning for MLLM serving, tangential to pretraining; just skim §3 framework figure and main results table.

paper.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visua

summary.core_problem: VLM推理时视觉token序列过长导致计算开销大，现有token剪枝在高压缩率下信息损失严重。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的方法改进，提出训练无关的保守token凝聚范式，属于增量型创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecFlow，将视觉token视为kNN图节点，通过谱热流计算重要性场、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、信息聚合到coreset sink保持统计守恒，无需微调。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM架构和任务上与现有SOTA token剪枝方法对比，高压缩率下性能更优，兼容FlashAttention，即插即用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual token sequences make VLM inference expensive; existing token pruning methods degrade severely under high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Incremental improvement in inference efficiency; proposes a training-free conservative token condensation paradigm as an alternative to destructive pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecFlow treats visual tokens as nodes in a kNN graph, computes importance via spectral heat flow, allocates budgets through adaptive spatial partitioning, and aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to preserve statistical conservation, requiring no fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple VLM architectures and tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art token pruning methods especially at high compression rates; plug-and-play and FlashAttention-compatible.

recommendation.zh: VLM视觉token压缩的工程改进，训练无关思路有参考价值但非范式突破，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement for VLM visual token compression; training-free design is worth noting but not paradigm-shifting—skim the method section only.

paper.title: Seeing Once is Enough? Online Geometry-Aware Token Pruning for 3D Question Answering
paper.abstract: Recent Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on 2D question answering tasks. However, extending these models to the 3D question answering remains challenging, as they typically require multiple views of the scene, which incurs substantial computational cost at inference. To mitigate this issue, existing solutions rely on strategic frame selection or token-merging algorithms that require preprocessing in advance all frames of the scene, i.e., an offlin

summary.core_problem: 降低多视角 3D Question Answering 中 MLLM 推理时的视觉 token 数量和显存开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，目标是 3D 多模态问答中的在线 token pruning。它不是预训练工作，但对多模态长输入的 token 冗余处理有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法利用深度信息和相机位姿，把每帧图像 token 投影到共享 voxel 空间，识别跨帧空间重叠区域，并在 token 进入语言模型前剪掉冗余 token。核心区别是在线处理，不需要提前读取并预处理整个场景，也不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM、3D QA 数据集、token 削减比例、显存下降幅度或准确率变化；声称可无训练接入现有 MLLM，并降低内存使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high visual-token and memory cost of multi-view MLLM inference for 3D question answering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for 3D multimodal QA. It is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful data-redundancy signal for handling multi-view visual inputs before the language model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method projects tokens from each incoming frame into a shared voxel space using depth and camera pose, detects spatial overlap across frames, and prunes redundant image tokens before they are fed to the language model. Unlike offline frame selection or token merging, it operates online and requires no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the evaluated MLLMs, 3D QA datasets, pruning ratios, memory savings, or accuracy trade-offs. It claims seamless integration with existing MLLMs and lower memory usage.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；它处理的是多视角 token 冗余，不改变 MLLM 训练范式。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; it is useful token-redundancy engineering, not a change to MLLM training.

paper.title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models with Prior-Corrected Token Reduction
paper.abstract: Visual token reduction has emerged as an effective strategy for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Many existing methods prune tokens by ranking text-visual attention scores. However, we show that attention is often dominated by a model-induced prior: even without textual instruction, MLLMs tend to focus on certain task-agnostic regions. Consequently, the attention scores of instruction-conditioned tokens are suppressed, increasing the risk that these tokens are discarded dur

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝中，文本-视觉注意力被模型固有先验主导，导致任务相关 token 被误删的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理加速方法和注意力信号分析。它提醒视觉 token reduction 不能直接把 cross-attention 当作任务条件重要性，注意力里混有与指令无关的区域偏好。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prior-Corrected Token Reduction，训练免费。方法先估计无文本指令或弱条件下的模型诱导先验注意力，再与任务条件下的后验注意力做对比，用二者差异衡量每个视觉 token 对当前指令额外提供的信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、benchmark 名称和提升幅度。实验主张是在不训练模型的前提下减少视觉 token，并尽量保持多模态推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual-token pruning in MLLMs where text-visual attention is contaminated by model-induced priors, causing task-relevant tokens to be pruned.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method plus a useful diagnostic about attention signals. It argues that cross-attention should not be treated as task-conditioned token importance without correcting for instruction-agnostic visual priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Prior-Corrected Token Reduction, a training-free pruning method. The method estimates a prior attention map induced by the model, contrasts it with the task-conditioned posterior attention, and ranks tokens by the additional usable information contributed under the current instruction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The claimed evaluation is training-free visual-token reduction with preserved multimodal reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和注意力先验分析即可；对预训练不直接，但能提醒别把 MLLM attention 当干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and prior-attention analysis; it is not pretraining work, but it cautions against treating MLLM attention as a clean supervision signal.

paper.title: AVIS: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) benefit from chain-of-thought prompting and test-time scaling, but these gains often come with prohibitive inference cost due to large visual contexts and long decoding chains. We view this cost through two coupled axes: Visual Context Scaling (VCS), which controls how much visual evidence is passed to the language model, and Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS), which controls how much inference-time reasoning search is performed. Existing methods typically optimi

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM测试时计算优化仅单独处理视觉上下文缩放或推理搜索缩放，未在两个耦合维度上做逐样本自适应分配，导致精度损失或计算冗余。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM推理中“视觉上下文质量”与“推理搜索深度”的耦合trade-off，这种测试时计算分配逻辑可反向指导预训练阶段的视觉token表示设计（如强化注意力key与信息冗余的关联），为多模态模型的预训练-推理协同设计提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案为两阶段自适应策略AVIS：一是视觉上下文缩放（VCS），用训练无关、O(N)复杂度的KDV剪枝，基于注意力key的多样性判断视觉token冗余度，prefill前剪枝以降低缓存与计算成本；二是视觉推理缩放（VRS），用轻量难度预测器给中等难度可解样本分配最多的CoT rollout（自一致性聚合结果），极端难易样本分配更少；结合共享prefill机制，剪枝后的KV缓存可在所有rollout间复用，将冗余视觉计算转移到有效推理搜索上。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen2.5-VL为主干，在图像/视频的数学推理、视觉推理、通用VQA等任务上评测，相比仅VCS/仅VRS基线，可在固定计算量下提升精度，或在同精度下降低FLOPs与延迟；共享prefill大幅降低并行推理搜索成本，消融实验验证了VCS-VRS trade-off曲面及与RL后训练模型的兼容性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看Introduction中“seeing（视觉上下文）-thinking（推理搜索）”两个计算维度的定义，再看Methodology中KDV剪枝与难度预测器的实现细节，最后查看实验中的FLOPs-精度trade-off曲线与延迟数据，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing test-time compute optimization for VLMs only handles visual context scaling or reasoning search scaling independently, without sample-wise adaptive allocation across the two coupled axes, resulting in either accuracy loss or redundant computation.
summary_en.importance: It uncovers the coupled trade-off between visual context quality and reasoning search depth in VLM inference. This test-time compute allocation logic can reversely guide visual token representation design during pretraining (e.g., strengthening the correlation between attention key diversity and information redundancy), providing insights for co-design of pretraining and inference pipelines for multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVIS is a two-stage adaptive policy: 1) Visual Context Scaling (VCS): training-free, O(N) Key Diversity Visual (KDV) pruning measures visual token redundancy via attention key diversity, and prunes redundant tokens before prefill to reduce KV cache footprint and compute cost; 2) Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS): a lightweight difficulty predictor allocates the largest number of CoT rollouts (aggregated via self-consistency and majority voting) to intermediate hard-but-solvable samples, with fewer rollouts assigned to extremely easy or hard samples. Combined with shared prefill, the pruned KV cache is reused across all rollouts, reallocating compute from redundant visual processing to effective reasoning search.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations use Qwen2.5-VL as the primary backbone, covering tasks including mathematical reasoning, visual reasoning, and general VQA on both images and videos. Compared with VCS-only and VRS-only baselines, the method improves accuracy under fixed compute budgets, or reduces FLOPs and latency under matched accuracy. Shared prefill drastically cuts the cost of parallel reasoning search. Ablations characterize the VCS-VRS trade-off surface and verify compatibility with RL post-trained models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first review the definition of the two compute axes ("seeing" for visual context, "thinking" for reasoning search) in Introduction, then check implementation details of KDV pruning and the difficulty predictor in Methodology, finally examine FLOPs-accuracy trade-off curves and latency data in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“视觉token预算”和“推理采样预算”当成同一张账来算是对的；只需看 KDV pruning 规则和难度预测器是否真的稳、是否跨数据集泛化。
recommendation.en: The right framing is joint budgeting of visual tokens and reasoning rollouts; skim the KDV pruning rule and the difficulty predictor—if they don’t generalize, it’s just another brittle heuristic.

paper.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relev

summary.core_problem: VLM 中常见的 visual token 剪枝是一次性永久丢弃，而不同解码器层对 token 的重要性判断会变化，导致 grounding 类查询受损。
summary.importance: 提出可恢复的视觉 token 路由范式替代 rank-and-remove，属于轻量、training-free 的推理效率方法。
summary.technical_approach: Reroute 为 training-free 插件：在每个路由阶段，被选中的视觉 token 进入当前 decoder 块，延迟的 token 跳过该阶段并在下一轮路由重新进入候选池，复用已有注意力打分规则和阶段调度，保持与被增强的剪枝方法相同的渐近 FLOPs 与 KV-cache 预算。
summary.experiments: 在多种 VLM + 多种现有 token 剪枝方法上做插件式替换（摘要截断，具体数据集/数值未完整给出），在相同 FLOPs/KV-cache 预算下比永久剪枝更稳，尤其改善 grounding 敏感查询。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-token reduction for VLMs permanently drops tokens, yet token importance shifts across decoder layers, hurting grounding-sensitive queries.
summary_en.importance: Proposes recoverable routing as an alternative to the rank-and-remove pruning paradigm; a training-free inference-efficiency plugin.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reroute is a training-free plug-in: at each routing stage selected visual tokens go through the decoder block while deferred tokens bypass and re-enter the candidate pool at the next stage, reusing existing attention-score ranking and stage-wise schedules, preserving the TFLOPs/KV-cache budget class of the underlying pruner.
summary_en.experiments: Plugged into multiple VLMs on top of existing pruning methods (details truncated); under matched FLOPs/KV-cache budgets it outperforms permanent removal, particularly for grounding-sensitive queries.

recommendation.zh: 对做 VLM 推理/多模态预训练的人有用："延迟而非丢弃"这个视角比剪枝更稳；纯文本 LLM 研究员看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on VLM inference or multimodal pretraining; the "defer instead of drop" framing is cleaner than hard pruning, but text-only pretrain folks can stop at the abstract.

paper.title: When Attention Collapses: Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning from Structure to Semantics
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but suffer from significant computational overhead during inference. While visual token pruning offers a promising solution, existing methods predominantly rely on initial attention scores. This single-metric paradigm presents a critical flaw: high attention scores inherently collapse onto semantically similar regions, thereby severely reducing feature diversity and discarding vital contextual details. To address this, we in

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的是 VLM 推理阶段的视觉 token 剪枝，但切入点不是单纯追求更高压缩率，而是指出现有 attention-based pruning 的一个结构性问题：如果只按注意力分数保留 token，高分 token 会在语义上彼此靠近，形成局部聚集，结果是保留了很多相似区域，却丢掉了全局结构和上下文细节。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何让剪枝策略符合表示在不同阶段的演化规律：进入 LLM 之前先保住结构多样性，进入 LLM 之后再按任务语义做进一步筛选。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏高质量推理优化，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的启发在两点。第一，它把视觉编码器和语言解码器中的表示动态分开分析，说明“一个统一重要性指标贯穿全流程”往往不成立，这对多模态统一建模、token budget 分配、以及未来训练时是否显式鼓励 token 多样性都有参考意义。第二，它揭示 attention score 不是天然可靠的 token saliency proxy，至少在视觉侧深层表示中会和特征相似性塌缩到一起。这个观察对做视觉 tokenizer、跨模态压缩、甚至训练期 token dropping 都有方法论价值。不过从筛选标准看，它主要属于 efficient/VLM inference 方向，和预训练的直接距离较远，适合泛读而非深挖。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 STS，Structure-to-Semantics，是一个 training-free 的两阶段剪枝框架。第一阶段发生在视觉编码器输出、送入 LLM 之前。作者不再直接按 attention 排序，而是把 token 选择写成一个受“势能/排斥”启发的采样目标：把每个视觉 token 看成特征空间中的带电粒子，语义越相似，排斥越强。这样选出的子集会主动避开语义上彼此过近的 token，从而保留更分散、更完整的结构信息。第二阶段发生在 LLM 中间层，利用 instruction-aware cross-attention 做语义相关性过滤，把与当前任务无关的视觉 token 再剪掉一部分。支撑这个设计的，是作者对两处表示动态的经验分析：在视觉编码器深层，feature-similar tokens 的 attention score 越来越相近，导致 attention 难以区分冗余 token；而在 LLM 解码器中，早层更偏广泛上下文聚合，深层才逐步集中到任务相关视觉区域。论文还提出了一个 KNN Consistency Score，用来量化“特征相近的 token 是否也拿到相近 attention 分数”，作为 attention collapse 的诊断指标。与已有单阶段 attention pruning 相比，STS 的区别不只是多加一步，而是把‘保结构多样性’和‘保任务语义’明确拆成两个阶段，并分别用不同信号处理。
summary.experiments: 实验在多个 VLM 和多个 benchmark 上做，目标是验证效率—性能折中。作者报告的主结论是：在较激进的 token reduction 下，STS 比单纯 attention-based pruning 更能维持任务性能，同时减少推理开销。经验分析部分先给出证据：在 LLaVA-1.5 上，随着视觉编码器层数加深，KNN Consistency Score 上升，说明 attention similarity 与 feature similarity 越来越绑定，单看 attention 更容易选出语义扎堆的 token。随后在下游评测中，STS 在相同保留 token 预算下通常优于对比方法，尤其在高压缩场景下更稳，因为第一阶段保住了全局结构覆盖，第二阶段再补上任务相关性。论文摘要和你提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格数值，因此这里不编造具体 latency、FLOPs 或准确率差值；阅读时应重点核对三类结果：不同压缩率下的性能曲线、两阶段各自的消融贡献、以及不同插入层位置对结果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“分析先行，方法随后”的顺序。先看 Empirical Analysis，尤其是 KNN Consistency Score 的定义和随层深变化的图，这部分决定了作者为什么认为 attention-only pruning 不够。然后看 STS 的两阶段设计：视觉侧的 repulsion-based sampling 怎么实现，LLM 中间层的语义剪枝用什么信号、插在哪一层。实验部分重点看 efficiency-performance trade-off 曲线和消融表，确认收益来自阶段解耦，而不是简单多剪一次。若只是判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟左右足够；若要复现或迁移到别的 VLM，需要细看附录中的实现细节、复杂度分析和不同模型上的超参数设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token pruning for VLM inference, but its main point is not just higher compression. It identifies a structural flaw in attention-based pruning: selecting tokens purely by attention tends to keep many semantically similar regions because high-attention tokens collapse into local clusters. That preserves redundancy while discarding global structure and contextual detail. The core problem is therefore stage mismatch: before the LLM, pruning should preserve structural diversity; inside the LLM, pruning should focus on task-specific semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from two observations. First, it separates representation dynamics in the vision encoder from those in the language decoder, showing that one universal token-importance signal is often the wrong abstraction. That is useful for multimodal token budgeting, compression-aware architecture design, and possibly training-time token dropping. Second, it argues that attention scores are not a reliable saliency proxy on the visual side once deeper representations become semantically clustered. That insight may matter beyond pruning, including visual tokenizers and multimodal compression. Still, the direct connection to pretraining is limited, so this is better treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, STS (Structure-to-Semantics), is a training-free two-stage pruning framework. Stage one operates before visual tokens enter the LLM. Instead of ranking tokens only by attention, it formulates token selection with a potential-energy or repulsion-inspired objective: tokens are treated like charged particles in feature space, and semantically similar tokens repel each other more strongly. This encourages a selected subset that is spatially and semantically diverse, preserving global structure. Stage two operates inside an intermediate LLM layer and uses instruction-aware cross-attention to remove task-irrelevant visual tokens. The design is motivated by empirical analysis of representation dynamics. In deeper vision layers, feature-similar tokens receive increasingly similar attention scores, so attention loses discriminative power within local semantic neighborhoods. In the LLM decoder, earlier layers aggregate broad context while deeper layers become more task-focused. The paper also introduces a KNN Consistency Score to quantify how strongly feature similarity aligns with attention similarity, serving as a diagnostic for attention collapse. Compared with prior single-stage pruning methods, the novelty is not just adding another pruning step, but explicitly decoupling structural coverage from semantic relevance and using different signals for each stage.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on multiple VLMs and benchmarks to evaluate the efficiency-performance trade-off. The main result is that STS preserves task performance better than attention-based baselines under the same token budget, especially in aggressive pruning regimes. The empirical-analysis section first shows evidence for the claimed failure mode: on LLaVA-1.5, the KNN Consistency Score increases with vision-layer depth, indicating that attention similarity increasingly tracks feature similarity, which makes attention-only selection more redundant. Downstream evaluations then show that the two-stage strategy is more robust because stage one preserves global structural coverage and stage two restores task relevance. The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains in latency, FLOPs, or benchmark scores should be read from the main paper. The most useful results to inspect are the performance curves across pruning ratios, the ablations for each stage, and the sensitivity to the layer where semantic pruning is inserted.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good reading order is analysis first, method second. Start with the empirical-analysis section, especially the definition of the KNN Consistency Score and the layerwise plots showing attention collapse. That section explains why attention-only pruning is insufficient. Then read the STS method details: how the repulsion-based sampling is implemented before the LLM, what signal is used for semantic pruning inside the LLM, and where that pruning is applied. In the experiments, focus on efficiency-performance trade-off plots and ablation tables to verify that the gain comes from stage-aware decoupling rather than simply pruning more. Around 30 minutes is enough for a decision-level read. For reproduction or adaptation to another VLM, the appendix will matter for implementation details, complexity, and hyperparameter settings.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝中常见的 'attention collapse' 问题，提出的两阶段解耦策略（先结构多样性后语义过滤）对多模态模型的推理优化有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Identifies the 'attention collapse' issue in VLM visual token pruning. The proposed two-stage decoupled strategy (structural diversity followed by semantic filtering) offers insights for multimodal model inference optimization.

institutions: National University of Singapore (Suzhou) Research Institute

paper.title: TRINE: A Token-Aware, Runtime-Adaptive FPGA Inference Engine for Multimodal AI
paper.abstract: Multimodal stacks that mix ViTs, CNNs, GNNs, and transformer NLP strain embedded platforms because their compute/memory patterns diverge and hard real-time targets leave little slack. TRINE is a single-bitstream FPGA accelerator and compiler that executes end-to-end multimodal inference without reconfiguration. Layers are unified as DDMM/SDDMM/SpMM and mapped to a mode-switchable engine that toggles at runtime among weight/output-stationary systolic, 1xCS SIMD, and a routable adder tree (RADT) o

summary.core_problem: 在嵌入式 FPGA 上高效执行由 ViT、CNN、GNN 和 transformer NLP 混合组成的多模态推理流水线，避免频繁重配置和低利用率。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理硬件与编译系统。它对 LLM serving 不是直接方案，但对 token pruning、异构层统一映射、低功耗多模态部署有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TRINE 使用单 bitstream FPGA accelerator/compiler，把不同层统一为 DDMM、SDDMM 和 SpMM 形式，并映射到可运行时切换模式的共享 PE array。执行模式包括 weight/output-stationary systolic、1xCS SIMD 和 routable adder tree；同时加入两阶段 top-k token pruning 和 dependency-aware layer offloading，以重叠独立 kernel。
summary.experiments: 系统在 Alveo U50 和 ZCU104 上评测。摘要报告 TRINE 在 20-21W 下相对 RTX 4090 延迟最高降低 22.57x，相对 Jetson Orin Nano 最高降低 6.86x；ViT-heavy pipeline 中 token pruning 最高带来 7.8x，加 DALO 最高提升 79% throughput，并使用 int8 quantization。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California, Irvine、Purdue University Northwest、Qualcomm 和 Samsung，组合偏硬件架构、编译和边缘 AI 加速。

summary_en.core_problem: TRINE targets efficient FPGA execution of multimodal inference pipelines that mix ViTs, CNNs, GNNs, and transformer NLP, avoiding reconfiguration overhead and low utilization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference hardware and compiler system. It is not a direct LLM-serving recipe, but it is useful background for token pruning, unified mapping of heterogeneous layers, and low-power multimodal deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRINE uses a single-bitstream FPGA accelerator/compiler that normalizes layers into DDMM, SDDMM, and SpMM forms and maps them to a shared PE array with runtime mode switching. The modes include weight/output-stationary systolic execution, 1xCS SIMD, and a routable adder tree; it also adds a two-stage top-k token-pruning unit and dependency-aware layer offloading to overlap independent kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on Alveo U50 and ZCU104. The abstract reports up to 22.57x lower latency than an RTX 4090 and 6.86x lower latency than a Jetson Orin Nano at 20-21W; token pruning gives up to 7.8x on ViT-heavy pipelines, DALO improves throughput by up to 79%, and int8 quantization is used.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of California, Irvine, Purdue University Northwest, Qualcomm, and Samsung, with the work centered on hardware architecture, compilation, and edge AI acceleration.

recommendation.zh: 硬件数字亮眼但 setup 偏嵌入式异构；只扫 token pruning 和 DALO，别外推到 LLM serving。
recommendation.en: The hardware numbers are eye-catching but embedded-heterogeneous; skim token pruning and DALO, and do not extrapolate to LLM serving.

paper.title: AsymVLM: Asymmetric Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process thousands of visual tokens per image alongside comparatively few text tokens, yet existing compression methods treat both modalities uniformly. We observe that the two modalities have fundamentally different properties: vision tokens are spatially redundant and dominate prefill, while text tokens are causally dependent and accumulate during decoding. Based on this asymmetry, we propose and empirically evaluate AsymVLM, which applies aggressive pruning to vis

summary.core_problem: AsymVLM 解决 VLM 推理中视觉 token 和文本 token 被同质化压缩的问题。视觉 token 数量大、空间冗余强，主要拖慢 prefill；文本 token 有自回归因果依赖，主要在长生成和多轮对话中累积 KV cache。两类 token 的结构和瓶颈不同，不适合用同一种剪枝策略。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于高效推理方向，对预训练的间接启发在于：VLM 的视觉 token 预算不应只由固定分辨率或固定压缩率决定，而应和样本的信息分布、问题类型、生成阶段绑定。它提醒视觉 tokenizer、视觉 projector 和 native multimodal 训练需要考虑“哪些视觉 token 真正影响语言输出”，而不只是视觉显著性或图文相似度。方法本身偏 inference，不改变预训练目标或训练 recipe，但对多模态模型的 token 经济性分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AsymVLM 把压缩拆成两条路径。对视觉 token，在进入 LLM transformer 之前做一次 query-aware pruning。它训练一个 cross-modal importance scorer，目标不是简单估计图像 patch 的语义显著性，而是最小化剪枝后 VLM 输出与未剪枝输出之间的差异，从而更贴近 token 对最终回答的贡献。随后使用 per-sample adaptive budget，根据每个样本视觉 token 重要性分布的间隔动态决定保留比例，避免固定剪枝率在局部问题上浪费计算、在全局计数问题上删掉关键信息。对文本 token，则不在早期激进删除，而是在生成长度超过固定预算后做轻量级 threshold-based KV eviction，以尽量保护自回归依赖。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个 VLM benchmark 上评估，报告 AsymVLM 在同类方法中取得最高 FLOPs savings，最高可达 54%。在 50% 视觉 token 保留率下，模型仍保持有竞争力的准确率。文本侧实验关注 free-form generation，结果显示面向 VLM 短上下文特性的阈值式 eviction 优于标准 LLM cache 方法。文中还给出关键观察：Phi-3.5-Vision 等配置中，单图常有约 2,500 个视觉 token，而文本输入通常只有 20–30 个 token，因此 prefill 阶段的主要开销来自视觉 token；但在长输出和多轮场景中，文本 KV cache 会逐步成为瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。优先看 Section 3.1 的经验分析，它解释为什么视觉和文本 token 需要不同策略；再看 Section 3.2 的 learned importance scorer，关注它如何用输出差异而不是语义相似度定义重要性；Section 3.3 的 adaptive budget 是方法中较有用的工程细节；Section 3.4 可快速浏览，理解文本 token eviction 的触发条件即可。实验部分重点看 FLOPs-accuracy tradeoff、50% vision token retention 的结果，以及 free-form generation 下文本 cache 方法的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: AsymVLM targets a mismatch in VLM inference compression: vision and text tokens are often pruned or cached with uniform policies, although they have different structures and bottlenecks. Vision tokens are numerous, spatially redundant, and dominate prefill cost. Text tokens are causally dependent and become a KV-cache issue mainly during long generation or multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an inference-efficiency work, but it has useful implications for multimodal pretraining and tokenizer design. It suggests that the useful visual token budget is sample-dependent and task-dependent, not just a fixed function of image resolution. It also shifts the criterion from visual saliency or image-text similarity to contribution to the final language output. That is relevant when designing visual tokenizers, projectors, and native multimodal training recipes, even though the proposed method itself does not modify the pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsymVLM uses different compression strategies for the two modalities. For vision tokens, it performs query-aware pruning before the LLM transformer layers. A learned cross-modal importance scorer ranks visual tokens by how much pruning them changes the VLM output, rather than relying only on semantic saliency or similarity. A per-sample adaptive budget then adjusts the retention ratio according to the importance distribution of each input. This avoids wasting compute on localized questions while preserving more tokens for tasks that require global visual coverage, such as counting scattered objects. For text tokens, the method avoids aggressive early removal because of causal dependencies. It applies lightweight threshold-based KV-cache eviction only after the generated text exceeds a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across multiple VLM benchmarks. AsymVLM achieves up to 54% FLOPs savings, while maintaining competitive accuracy at 50% vision-token retention. For free-form generation, its text-token eviction strategy outperforms standard LLM cache methods by adapting to the shorter-context and image-conditioned nature of VLM decoding. A central empirical observation is that models such as Phi-3.5-Vision may process around 2,500 vision tokens for an image while the text prompt often has only 20–30 tokens, making vision tokens the main prefill bottleneck. During long outputs or multi-turn dialogue, the bottleneck can shift to accumulated text KV cache.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is enough. Start with Section 3.1, which motivates the modality-asymmetric design through empirical analysis. Then read the learned importance scorer in Section 3.2, especially how token importance is tied to output preservation rather than pure semantic relevance. Section 3.3 is worth reading for the adaptive-budget mechanism. Section 3.4 can be skimmed to understand when text-token eviction is triggered. In the experiments, focus on the FLOPs-accuracy tradeoff, the results at 50% vision-token retention, and the comparison against standard cache methods in free-form generation.

recommendation.zh: 把VLM的prefill视觉冗余和decode文本因果链拆开处理是对的；只看剪视觉token的打分器+预算策略，别被“文本eviction”细节带跑偏。
recommendation.en: The key insight—separating visual prefill redundancy from text causal decoding—is solid; focus on the visual pruning scorer/budgeting, and treat text eviction as a secondary heuristic.

paper.title: OccamToken: Efficient VLM Inference with Training-Free and Budget-Adaptive Token Pruning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on long visual token sequences for visual understanding, making the prefill stage expensive in both computation and memory. Most existing pruning methods follow an absolute-ranking paradigm, assigning importance scores to visual tokens and retaining a fixed top-K subset. In this work, we argue that this paradigm is fundamentally brittle: attention sinks distort token importance rankings, while image redundancy and query-dependent visual evidence make fixed toke

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言模型的视觉token剪枝采用绝对重要性排序范式，受注意力沉降扭曲排序、固定token预算适配性差的问题，导致预填充阶段计算和内存开销过高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需训练、自适应预算的视觉token剪枝框架，突破了传统绝对排序范式的固有缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OccamToken框架，用寄存器锚定的相对证据测试替代全局绝对排序，以寄存器吸收低信息注意力模式后的输出为参考，判断视觉token是否提供额外有效信息。
summary.experiments: 论文未披露具体模型参数量和训练数据规模，核心实验为验证相对证据测试相比绝对排序的鲁棒性，未给出具体量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual token pruning methods for VLMs adopt an absolute ranking paradigm, which is distorted by attention sinks and unreliable due to fixed token budgets across different inputs, leading to high prefill computation and memory costs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free, budget-adaptive visual token pruning framework that overcomes the inherent flaws of the traditional absolute ranking paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OccamToken, which replaces global absolute token ranking with register-anchored relative evidence testing, using register outputs that naturally absorb low-information attention patterns as a reference to judge whether a visual token provides additional valid information.
summary_en.experiments: The paper does not disclose specific model parameter sizes or training data scale. Core experiments verify the robustness of relative evidence testing compared to absolute ranking, without providing specific quantitative improvement metrics.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态推理效率方向的小创新可备查，核心思路对预训练研究员无直接启发，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Can be kept as a reference for multimodal inference efficiency minor innovations; no direct insight for pretraining researchers, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Beyond Surrogate Gradients: Fully Differentiable Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the computational cost of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens. Existing methods typically rely on Gumbel-Softmax to approximate discrete selection during training. However, the optimization is driven by surrogate gradients rather than the true selection process, leading to unreliable learning of token importance. In this paper, we propose DiffPrune, which reformulates pruning as continuous control of token information instead of discrete

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝训练中离散选择不可微、依赖 Gumbel-Softmax 代理梯度导致 token 重要性学习不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 推理效率方法。它把剪枝训练从“学习离散选择”改写为“连续控制 token 信息量”，对视觉 token 压缩和多模态推理成本控制有参考价值，但不直接推进基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiffPrune。核心模块是 Information Throttler：根据每个视觉 token 的重要性分数注入方差保持噪声，分数越高信息抑制越少。训练时直接在 token 表征上建立可微路径；推理时再根据学到的分数做硬阈值删除。方法更像对 token 信息通道的连续门控，而不是对离散保留/删除决策做松弛近似。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 10 个 VLM benchmark 上验证 DiffPrune，但未提供具体 VLM 架构、参数量、剪枝率、吞吐提升、精度变化或相对 Gumbel-Softmax 剪枝方法的提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable visual-token pruning in VLMs caused by non-differentiable discrete selection and reliance on Gumbel-Softmax surrogate gradients.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for VLMs. It reframes pruning training from learning discrete selection to continuously controlling token information, which is useful for visual-token compression and multimodal serving cost, but it is not a direct pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiffPrune introduces an Information Throttler that injects variance-preserving noise into visual tokens according to learned importance scores. Higher scores preserve more information during training. This creates a fully differentiable path through token representations, while inference uses hard thresholding over the learned scores to remove tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation on ten VLM benchmarks, but does not provide concrete VLM backbones, parameter counts, pruning ratios, throughput gains, accuracy changes, or margins over Gumbel-Softmax-based pruning baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表即可；连续信息节流比 Gumbel 代理更干净，但缺少规模和收益数字前先别外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and main tables; continuous information throttling is cleaner than Gumbel surrogates, but do not extrapolate without scale and speed numbers.

paper.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
paper.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) achieve unified audio-visual understanding by encoding video and audio into temporally aligned token sequences interleaved at the window level. However, processing these dense non-textual tokens throughout the LLM incurs substantial computational overhead. Although training-free token selection can reduce this cost, existing methods either focus on visual-only inputs or prune om-LLM tokens only before the LLM with fixed per-modality ratios, failing to c

summary.core_problem: 解决 omni-modal LLM 在视频和音频 token 密集输入下推理成本过高，而现有 token pruning 不能反映跨模态 token 重要性随层深变化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是典型高效推理工作，但有一条对统一多模态预训练也有价值的观察：音视频 token 依赖呈 block-wise 模式，且在深层逐渐减弱，说明跨模态融合后晚层存在大量冗余非文本 token。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SEATS，一种 training-free、stage-adaptive token selection 方法。先分析 om-LLM 的 layer-wise token dependency，再在进入 LLM 前和 LLM 内不同 stage 采用不同的音频/视觉 token 保留策略，而不是固定每模态比例的一次性裁剪。核心是按层深动态调整 pruning 强度，利用早层融合、晚层冗余的结构特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名和压缩比，但应在 omni-modal LLM 推理场景下与 visual-only pruning 和 fixed-ratio om-LLM pruning 比较，指标大概率包括吞吐、FLOPs/latency 与任务精度保持。价值主要在 dependency analysis 和无训练部署便利性。
summary.authors_note: 来自中国人民大学、WeChat Vision、腾讯。腾讯在多模态系统和部署优化上积累较深，这类工作通常工程针对性较强。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high inference cost of omni-modal LLMs with dense video and audio tokens, where existing token pruning methods fail to capture how cross-modal token importance changes with depth.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper, but it contains a useful observation for unified multimodal pretraining as well: audio and visual token dependencies are block-wise and weaken with depth, implying substantial late-layer redundancy after cross-modal fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SEATS, a training-free stage-adaptive token selection method. It first analyzes layer-wise token dependency in omni-modal LLMs, then applies different token retention strategies before and within the LLM across stages, instead of a one-shot fixed per-modality pruning ratio. The core idea is depth-aware pruning that exploits early fusion and late redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model names or compression ratios, but the setup likely compares against visual-only pruning and fixed-ratio omni-modal pruning on throughput, FLOPs/latency, and accuracy retention. The main value is the dependency analysis and zero-training deployability.
summary_en.authors_note: From Renmin University of China, WeChat Vision, and Tencent. Tencent has strong experience in multimodal systems and deployment-oriented optimization, so the work is likely engineering-conscious.

recommendation.zh: 做统一多模态的人可以看它的层间依赖分析：若晚层音视频 token 真普遍冗余，训练时的 token budget 和 stage design 都该重想；正文先看 dependency 结果。
recommendation.en: If you work on unified multimodal models, read the dependency analysis first: if late-layer audio/video tokens are broadly redundant, both training token budgets and stage design need revisiting.

paper.title: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large VIsion-Language Models
paper.abstract: In large vision-language models, visual tokens typically constitute the majority of input tokens, leading to substantial computational overhead. To address this, recent studies have explored pruning redundant or less informative visual tokens for image understanding tasks. However, these methods struggle with pixel grounding tasks, where token importance is highly contingent on the input text. Through an in-depth analysis of CLIP, we observe that visual tokens located within referent regions oft

summary.core_problem: 解决大视觉语言模型在 pixel grounding 任务中视觉 token 数量过多、推理开销高，而常规 token pruning 会删掉目标区域的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法与机制观察：指出 CLIP 文本-视觉相似度在指代区域上可能反而偏低，因此直接保留高相似 token 不适合 grounding。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LiteLVLM，一种 training-free、text-guided visual token pruning 策略；核心做法是反转 CLIP visual-text similarity 排序，优先保留与文本相似度低但可能位于 referent region 的视觉 token，并恢复部分上下文 token 以区分前景和背景。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 pixel grounding 任务上显著优于现有视觉 token pruning 方法，但未提供具体模型、token 保留率、延迟收益或精度提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high inference cost of large vision-language models on pixel grounding tasks, where naive visual token pruning can remove tokens that belong to the referred region.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method plus an empirical observation: CLIP visual tokens inside the referred region can have low similarity to the text representation, making standard high-similarity retention unreliable for grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes LiteLVLM, a training-free text-guided visual token pruning strategy. The key idea is to reverse CLIP visual-text similarity ranking, retain tokens likely to cover the referent region, and recover context tokens for foreground-background separation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial gains over existing pruning methods for pixel grounding, but gives no concrete model names, token retention ratios, latency numbers, or accuracy deltas.

recommendation.zh: 只看 CLIP 相似度反转这个观察即可；它是 grounding 推理特例，不应外推成通用 VLM token pruning 原则。
recommendation.en: Read only the reversed-CLIP-similarity observation; it is a grounding-specific inference trick and should not be generalized to VLM token pruning broadly.

paper.title: Keep What Audio Cannot Say: Context-Preserving Token Pruning for Omni-LLMs
paper.abstract: Omnimodal Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) incur substantial computational overhead due to the large number of multimodal input tokens they process, making token reduction essential for real-world deployment. Existing Omni-LLM pruning methods typically reduce this cost by selecting tokens that are important for the current query or strongly aligned with cross-modal cues. However, such strategies can discard evidence that falls outside these criteria, even when needed for different questions or

summary.core_problem: Omni-LLM 在处理视频、音频等多模态输入时 token 数量过大，现有剪枝方法容易丢掉当前 query 未显式需要、但后续理解仍可能依赖的上下文证据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理阶段的多模态 token 剪枝方法。它的价值不在预训练目标，而在提出一种更接近“保留互补信息、删除跨模态冗余”的剪枝准则，可作为多模态长上下文压缩的工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ContextGuard。核心思路是先从音频预测粗粒度视觉语义，再剪掉那些粗语义可由音频恢复的视频 token，同时保留额外的视频 token 来维持局部视觉上下文。它不是按当前问题相关性选择 token，而是把音视频之间的可恢复性作为冗余估计。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数量或提升幅度。实验应主要比较现有 query-aware 或 cross-modal alignment 型 Omni-LLM token pruning 方法，并验证在降低视频 token 数量时对多问题、多上下文理解的保持能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAIST；Joon Son Chung 长期做音视频理解、视听语音和多模态感知相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-LLMs process many audio-visual tokens at inference time, and existing pruning methods can discard contextual evidence that is not aligned with the current query but is still needed for broader understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful idea is to prune cross-modal redundancy while keeping modality-specific context, which is relevant to multimodal long-context compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces ContextGuard. It predicts coarse visual semantics from audio, removes video tokens whose coarse semantics are likely recoverable from the audio stream, and retains additional visual tokens for localized context. The pruning criterion is recoverability across modalities, not only query relevance or cross-modal alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares against query-aware and audio-visual alignment-based pruning methods under token budget constraints for Omni-LLM understanding.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from KAIST; Joon Son Chung is known for work on audio-visual perception and speech-related multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝准则即可：把“音频可恢复的视觉语义”当冗余，比按 query 选 token 更适合开放式多模态上下文。
recommendation.en: Read only the pruning criterion: treating audio-recoverable visual semantics as redundancy is cleaner than query-only token selection for open-ended multimodal context.

institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

paper.title: VisMMOE: Exploiting Visual-Expert Affinity for Efficient Visual-Language MoE Offloading
paper.abstract: Large-scale vision-language mixture-of-experts (VL-MoE) models provide strong multimodal capability, but efficient deployment on memory-constrained platforms remains difficult. Existing MoE offloading systems are largely designed for text-centric workloads and become much less effective for visual-heavy inputs, where large numbers of visual tokens induce broader and less predictable expert accesses. We present VisMMoE, a VL-MoE offloading system built on a single systems insight: pruning redunda

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是视觉语言 MoE 在单 GPU 或显存受限环境下的 expert offloading 延迟问题，重点是视觉 token 会激活更分散、更难预测的专家集合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏推理系统。但它有一个值得保留的观察：视觉 token 压缩不只减少 FLOPs，也会改变 MoE router 的专家访问分布。这个现象对多模态 MoE 的架构设计、视觉 tokenizer、router 训练和 serving-aware pretraining 都有启发。多模态模型里的 token 冗余会通过路由放大成参数访问冗余，这一点比普通 token pruning 更接近基座模型系统协同问题。
summary.technical_approach:
VisMMOE 的核心概念是 visual-expert affinity。作者观察到，原始视觉 token 往往让 MoE 层访问较大的 expert working set，导致 cache reuse 下降、PCIe 传输增加、prefetch 失准。剪掉冗余视觉 token 后，专家访问会更集中，跨层也更稳定。

系统由几部分组成。Affinity-Aware Token Compressor 不只按语义重要性保留视觉 token，还考虑保留下来的 token 是否会造成分散的 expert demand。Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor 利用压缩后的 token 和早期路由信息预测后续层需要的专家集合，从而扩大预取窗口。Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator 负责在 GPU 显存、主机内存和 PCIe 带宽约束下协调计算、专家传输、缓存替换和 pipeline overlap。

和文本 MoE offloading 系统相比，它的区别在于把视觉 token 压缩纳入 offloading 策略，而不是只做 expert cache 或 router 预测。和常规视觉 token pruning 相比，它优化的目标也不只是精度和计算量，还包括专家工作集的紧凑性和可预测性。
summary.experiments:
论文在 commodity GPU 平台上评测了代表性的 VL-MoE 模型，并与实际可用的 offloading baseline 对比。给定内容说明 VisMMOE 能降低端到端推理延迟，同时保持接近原模型的任务精度。实验应覆盖不同显存预算、不同视觉 token 数量、不同 expert pool 大小，以及 cache/prefetch 策略。

给定材料没有提供具体延迟降低比例、准确率变化和硬件配置数值，因此这些数字需要直接查实验表。泛读时更应关注趋势：视觉 token 越多、expert pool 越大、显存越紧，visual-expert affinity 带来的系统收益应越明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看动机部分和 Figure 1，确认视觉 token 是否真的造成更分散的 expert activation，以及 pruning 后访问模式是否变集中。然后看系统设计中 token compressor 和 lookahead predictor 的接口，理解它如何把 token 选择和 expert 预取绑定起来。实验部分重点看端到端 latency、cache hit rate、prefetch accuracy、accuracy drop 四类指标。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读 pipeline 工程细节，但值得记下 router 分布会被视觉 token 冗余显著扰动这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient offloading for vision-language MoE models under tight GPU memory budgets. The key issue is that visual-heavy inputs activate a broader and less predictable set of experts than text-only inputs, which makes expert caching and prefetching less effective.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the link between visual token redundancy and MoE routing behavior. Visual token pruning does not only reduce compute; it can also make expert demand more compact and predictable. This matters for multimodal MoE design, router training, visual tokenization, and serving-aware model construction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VisMMOE is built around the idea of visual-expert affinity. The authors profile VL-MoE workloads and observe that raw visual tokens scatter expert accesses across layers. After pruning redundant visual tokens, the expert working set becomes smaller and more stable.

The system combines three components. The Affinity-Aware Token Compressor selects visual tokens while considering both task fidelity and expert-locality effects. The Compression-Guided Lookahead Predictor uses the compressed token stream and early routing signals to predict future expert demand, giving the runtime a larger prefetch window. The Expert Caching and Pipeline Orchestrator coordinates GPU memory, host-to-device transfers, computation, cache replacement, and overlap.

The difference from standard MoE offloading is that token compression becomes part of the offloading policy. The difference from ordinary visual token pruning is that the objective includes expert working-set compactness, not only semantic salience or FLOP reduction.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates VisMMOE on representative VL-MoE models and commodity GPU platforms. The provided content states that it reduces end-to-end inference latency compared with practical baselines while maintaining competitive accuracy. The relevant experiments should include latency under different memory budgets, cache reuse, prefetch accuracy, visual token counts, and expert-pool sizes.

Exact latency reductions, accuracy deltas, and hardware configurations are not included in the supplied material. The main trend to verify in the tables is whether the benefit grows with more visual tokens, larger expert pools, and tighter memory constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the profiling figures, especially the comparison between text tokens, raw visual tokens, and pruned visual tokens in terms of expert activation patterns. Then read the design of the token compressor and lookahead predictor to see how token selection is tied to expert prefetching. In the evaluation, focus on end-to-end latency, cache hit rate, prefetch precision or recall, and accuracy loss. The pipeline details are less central unless the goal is to implement a similar offloading runtime.

recommendation.zh: 系统味很重但 insight 真实：token pruning 会改变 MoE 路由分布与工作集；只看 affinity 定义和缓存命中/working-set 曲线。
recommendation.en: Systems-heavy but the insight is real: token pruning changes MoE routing and the expert working set; skim the affinity definition and the cache-hit/working-set plots.

paper.title: HeadRouter: Dynamic Head-Weight Routing for Task-Adaptive Audio Token Pruning in Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent large audio language models (LALMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in processing extended multi-modal sequences, yet incur high inference costs. Token compression is an effective method that directly reduces redundant tokens in the sequence. Existing compression methods usually assume that all attention heads in LALMs contribute equally to various audio tasks and calculate token importance by averaging scores across all heads. However, our analysis demonstrates that attention heads e

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是大音频语言模型推理阶段的音频 token 压缩问题。已有方法常把所有注意力头一视同仁，用跨头平均的注意力分数做 token 重要性估计；作者指出这在音频场景里不成立，因为不同头对语义类任务和声学类任务的响应差异很大，而且真正对音频有贡献的头是稀疏的。结果是，统一的剪枝规则会在某些任务上错删关键信息，尤其在长音频和高压缩率下更明显。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，因为它不改预训练目标、数据或架构，而是推理时的训练免调优压缩方法。但它有两个启发点值得记住。第一，注意力头在跨模态模型里并不是均匀可替换的，头的功能分化可以作为动态路由信号，而不只是解释性现象。第二，音频 token 压缩不能照搬文本或视觉里的位置启发式，必须考虑语音/非语音结构、语义任务与声学任务的差异。对做语音 LM、统一多模态 LM、长上下文推理优化的人，这个观察有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeadRouter，核心是“先判断当前输入更像语义任务还是声学任务，再按这个判断去重配各注意力头的权重”，最后用重加权后的注意力分数做 token 剪枝。具体分三步。第一步，作者对每个注意力头计算基于熵的 selectivity score，用来衡量该头对音频 token 的注意力是否集中；注意力越集中，说明该头更有选择性。第二步，把所有头的 selectivity 的标准差作为一个紧凑路由信号：标准差低时，输入更接近语义型；标准差高时，更接近声学型。这个设计对应作者的经验观察：语义任务上的头权重分布更平缓，声学任务上更尖锐、更异质。第三步，不是硬切换到某一种头配置，而是在三组预先标定的 head-weight profile——semantic、uniform、acoustic——之间做 Gaussian soft mixing，得到样本级连续权重，再据此汇总头级注意力，给每个音频 token 打分并剪枝。作者还强调使用 no-RoPE 的选择性统计来减轻位置偏置，因为一些已有方法会偏向保留尾部 token。和 FastV、Frame 这类方法相比，区别不在于更复杂的打分器，而在于把“任务异质性”和“头行为异质性”显式纳入压缩策略，而且整个过程不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 AudioMarathon 和 MMAU-Pro 两个综合音频评测上做，覆盖语义理解与声学分析。论文给出的最醒目结果是：在移除 30% 音频 token 时，HeadRouter 不但没有掉点，反而超过未剪枝基线；在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上 AudioMarathon 平均分提升 1.2 分，在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上提升 2.1 分。作者把它与固定 head profile、均匀跨头平均、位置/时间采样、已有 attention-based pruning 方法做比较，在更激进的剪枝率下仍更稳。消融的关键信息有三类：一是语义/声学两端的 head profile 确实不同，固定单一 profile 会在另一类任务上明显吃亏；二是 soft mixing 比硬路由更稳，说明任务边界不是离散的；三是 no-RoPE selectivity 与音频结构更一致，能减少“保尾弃前”的位置偏置。论文还展示了 oracle 剪枝模式，说明有效保留往往集中在 voiced segments，而不是均匀时间采样。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三部分。先看引言里的 Figure 1、2、3，理解作者为什么认为音频任务异质性会让统一剪枝失效。再看分析部分关于 head-behavior heterogeneity 的图，尤其语义任务和声学任务的头分布差异，这决定了方法是否站得住。最后看方法图和主结果表，确认 routing signal、三种 profile、soft mixing 分别带来什么收益。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得复现，优先看 30% 以上剪枝率下与 unpruned baseline 和强基线的对比，以及消融里 soft vs hard routing、with vs without no-RoPE 的差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies inference-time audio token pruning for large audio-language models. Existing attention-based pruning methods typically average attention scores across all heads, implicitly assuming that heads contribute equally to all audio tasks. The authors show this assumption breaks in audio: only a sparse subset of heads is strongly audio-responsive, and the useful heads differ substantially between semantic tasks and acoustic tasks. As a result, a single global pruning rule tends to remove task-critical information, especially under long-context and aggressive compression settings.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, since it does not modify the training objective, data mixture, or model architecture. Its value is more indirect. First, it provides a concrete example that head specialization in multimodal models is operationally useful, not just an interpretability artifact. Second, it argues that audio compression should be structure-aware: voiced vs. silent regions, semantic vs. acoustic objectives, and modality-specific attention behavior matter more than generic positional heuristics. That is relevant for researchers working on speech/audio LMs, unified multimodal LMs, and long-context efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeadRouter is a training-free, per-sample routing method that first infers whether an input behaves more like a semantic task or an acoustic task, then reweights attention heads accordingly before scoring tokens for pruning. The method has three main steps. First, for each attention head, it computes an entropy-based selectivity score measuring how concentrated the head’s attention is over audio tokens; sharper attention implies stronger selectivity. Second, it uses the standard deviation of these selectivity scores across heads as a compact routing signal. Low variance indicates a more semantic-like regime, while high variance indicates a more acoustic-like regime, matching the authors’ empirical observation that acoustic tasks induce more heterogeneous head behavior. Third, instead of hard-switching between discrete modes, it performs Gaussian soft mixing over three pre-calibrated head-weight profiles—semantic, uniform, and acoustic—to obtain a continuous sample-specific head weighting. These weights are then used to aggregate head-level attention into token importance scores for pruning. A notable implementation detail is the use of no-RoPE selectivity statistics to reduce positional bias; prior methods tend to over-retain tail tokens. Relative to methods such as FastV or temporal subsampling, the main difference is not a more complex scorer but an explicit use of task heterogeneity and head heterogeneity, without any additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on AudioMarathon and MMAU-Pro, covering both semantic understanding and acoustic analysis. The headline result is that HeadRouter can outperform the unpruned baseline while removing 30% of audio tokens: on AudioMarathon, it improves the average score by +1.2 points for Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and +2.1 points for Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. The paper compares against fixed head profiles, uniform cross-head averaging, temporal/positional subsampling, and prior attention-based pruning baselines, and reports more stable behavior under higher pruning ratios. The most useful ablations are: (1) semantic and acoustic head profiles are genuinely different, and a single fixed profile hurts one side or the other; (2) soft profile mixing is more robust than hard routing, suggesting task regimes are not cleanly discrete; and (3) no-RoPE selectivity better matches audio structure and reduces the tail-retention bias seen in prior methods. The oracle pruning visualizations also support the claim that effective retention aligns with voiced segments rather than uniform temporal sampling.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction figures that motivate task heterogeneity and show why one-size-fits-all pruning fails. Then read the analysis section on head-behavior heterogeneity, especially the contrast between semantic and acoustic tasks; that is the empirical foundation of the method. Finally, inspect the method diagram and the main result tables to see how much each component matters: routing signal, profile design, and soft mixing. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If deciding whether to reproduce it, focus on comparisons at 30%+ pruning, and on the ablations for soft vs. hard routing and with vs. without no-RoPE statistics.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了音频 LM 中 attention head 的任务特异性稀疏激活模式，提出的 training-free token pruning 方法对多模态长上下文推理优化有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals task-specific sparse activation patterns of attention heads in audio LMs; the proposed training-free token pruning method is inspiring for multimodal long-context inference optimization.

summary.importance: 机制分析+方法创新，首次验证视觉编码器存在attention sink现象，提出用LLM中间层跨模态注意力作为剪枝指导信号
summary.technical_approach: 分析视觉编码器与LLM的注意力分布差异，发现视觉编码器attention sink使注意力偏向无意义背景区域，而LLM中间层的文本到视觉跨模态注意力不受位置偏置影响，因此用该层注意力分数裁剪不重要的视觉token
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM理解基准上测试，剪枝60%视觉token时精度损失小于1%，效果优于基于视觉编码器注意力的剪枝方法
summary.authors_note: 作者来自理想汽车智能研发团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual token pruning methods for VLMs rely on attention scores from vision encoders or LLMs, but vision encoders suffer from attention sink which leads to inaccurate identification of important tokens and poor pruning performance
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis + method innovation, first verifies attention sink exists in vision encoders, proposes using cross-modal attention from LLM middle layers as pruning guidance signal
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyze the attention distribution difference between vision encoders and LLMs, find that attention sink in vision encoders makes attention biased to meaningless background regions, while text-to-vision cross-modal attention in LLM middle layers is free of position bias, so use this layer's attention scores to prune unimportant visual tokens
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple VLM understanding benchmarks, accuracy drop is less than 1% when pruning 60% visual tokens, outperforms pruning methods based on vision encoder attention
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the R&D team of Li Auto

recommendation.zh: 仅对做VLM推理优化的研究员有参考价值，关注视觉编码器存在attention sink的发现即可，无需读全文
recommendation.en: Only useful for researchers working on VLM inference optimization, just note the attention sink finding in vision encoders, no need to read full paper
